$comment: Player equipment. Cooldowns and lifetimes are in milliseconds and are the only place those numbers live. A dropped slick or cloud is world-static: it stays where it was laid. The rocket's `range` is its fuse, and the flame's `range` is the far edge of its cone.

weapons.label: MACHINE GUN
weapons.description: Twin forward guns. The only weapon that works at range.

weapons.label: OIL SLICK
weapons.description: Lays a slick on the road ahead. Pursuers that cross it lose control and drift.

weapons.label: SMOKE SCREEN
weapons.description: Lays a cloud across the road. Hostiles beyond it stop firing.

weapons.label: ROCKETS
weapons.description: Forward rocket. Detonates on the first thing it touches and hurts everything inside the blast.

weapons.label: FLAME
weapons.description: Short-range cone of fire. Burns whatever is in front of the car and reaches nothing beyond it.
